capture_method: official FDA PDF text inspection; normalized metadata and paraphrased evidence only

locators.claim: Reviewer guides document study-data considerations that help reviewers understand submitted data.
The analysis data reviewer guide provides context for analysis datasets and conformance findings beyond define.xml.
Clinical tabulation and analysis data are interpreted within applicable CDISC and FDA-supported standards.
Validation findings and traceability need study-context interpretation; automated checks are not the whole quality assessment.

rights_note: This repository stores only project-authored metadata and paraphrases; the FDA document is nonbinding and the official current version remains authoritative.
